Mejiro McQueen delivered great results at 
the Kobe Shimbun Hai.

Her next challenge, vital for entering the 
Tenno Sho, is a race she cannot afford to 
lose: the final Classic race, the Kikuka 
Sho.

Anticipating a showdown with Mejiro Ryan 
on the Classic route, Mejiro McQueen fired 
herself up, aiming for victory.
